statement_type is one of GRAPH_FACT, CASE_FACT, USER_PROVIDED_FACT, REASONED_SUGGESTION or CLARIFICATION_QUESTION, and is never an action name such as CONFIRM_ORDER or ORDER_SEARCH — action names and statement types are separate vocabularies. A detail the associate gives you is settled the moment they give it, and a message that says confirm settles everything it names.
